payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_record_migrate.py::test_a_live_gate_results_failure_detail_is_set_aside stayed green with the spec's wrong version "`migrate` refuses a task whose tail disagrees only after it has already appended that tail to `record`, leaving the refused task's record one fact longer than it was." applied to saffron/record/migrate.py as an edit. The claim was 'The disagreement half of `test_a_live_gate_results_failure_detail_is_set_aside` (`tests/test_record_migrate.py:2629-2649`) hand-builds a fresh `MemoryRecord`, seeds it fact by fact, calls `migrate` and asserts `dict(refused.refused) == {key: f"the record holds {len(held)} fact(s) that disagree"}`. That is the same seed, the same `migrate` call and the same reason string `_assert_disagrees` (`tests/test_record_migrate.py:2218-2231`) already carries for every other disagreeing ref this file tests, with one check the inline block never makes: that the seeded record reads back unchanged after the refusal. Replace the inline block with one call, `_assert_disagrees(source_path, key, modified_held)`, where `modified_held` is `held` with the first `gate_result` fact\'s first failure\'s `message` replaced, built the same way the inline block built it. Change no other line of the test and no production file.'. Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_record_migrate.py::test_a_rerun_completes_a_migration_cut_short_and_refuses_a_record_that_disagrees, tests/test_record_migrate.py::test_each_compared_kind_that_disagrees_or_runs_past_the_ledger_is_refused, tests/test_saffron_gates.py::test_the_fast_gates_name_their_tool_and_pass_on_a_clean_tree[format], and the criterion's witness did not fail.
